    IReadOnlyList<FieldError> Errors, string? ConfirmationToken = null,
    int CandidateCount = 0, IReadOnlyList<StudentRow>? Candidates = null, string? RequestId = null);
public interface IStudentService
{
    Task<SearchResult> SearchAsync(SearchCriteria criteria, CancellationToken ct = default);
    Task<StudentDetail?> GetAsync(long id, CancellationToken ct = default);
    Task<LookupSet> LookupAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    Task<LookupSet> LookupAsync(bool includeOccupancy,CancellationToken ct = default) => LookupAsync(ct);
    Task<SaveResult> SaveAsync(SaveRequest request, CancellationToken ct = default);
    Task<SaveResult> DeleteAsync(long id, long version, string reason, CancellationToken ct = default);
}
","source/Web/Controllers/StudentsController.cs":"using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using StudentManagement.Core;
namespace StudentManagement.Web;
[Authorize,Route("students")]
public sealed class StudentsController(WebStudentCoordinator coordinator,IStudentService service,SearchContextStore contexts,RequestIdentity identity,FlashMessageStore flash,EditorSnapshotStore snapshots) : Controller
{
    [HttpGet("")] public async Task<IActionResult> Index(string? contextId,string? contextRevision,CancellationToken ct) {
        identity.Read();var entry=string.IsNullOrEmpty(contextId)?coordinator.NewContext():contexts.Get(contextId,identity.CurrentUser);object data=WebStudentCoordinator.Present(entry,null);
        if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(contextId))data=await coordinator.Resume(new ContextRequest {ContextId=entry.Id,ContextRevision=contextRevision??""},null,ct);
        var criteria=entry.Applied is null?new StudentSearchInput():From(entry.Applied);return View("Search",await SearchModel(entry,data,criteria,flash.Take(identity.CurrentUser,entry.Id),ct));
    }
    [HttpPost("search")] public async Task<IActionResult> Search([Bind(Prefix="Criteria")]StudentSearchInput input,string contextId,string contextRevision,string tabId,int pageSize=20,string sortKey="studentNo",string sortDirection="asc",CancellationToken ct=default) {
        await FormGuard("Criteria",typeof(StudentSearchInput),"ContextId","ContextRevision","TabId","PageSize","SortKey","SortDirection");if(!Request.Form.ContainsKey("Criteria.StatusCodes"))input.StatusCodes=[];var entry=contexts.Get(contextId,identity.CurrentUser,tabId);object data=WebStudentCoordinator.Present(entry,null);
        if(ModelState.IsValid) { try {data=await coordinator.Search(new SearchRequest {ContextId=contextId,ContextRevision=contextRevision,Criteria=input,PageSize=pageSize,SortKey=sortKey,SortDirection=sortDirection},tabId,ct);}catch(WebFault e) {ModelState.AddModelError(e.Field??"",e.Message);Response.StatusCode=e.Status;} } else Response.StatusCode=422;
        var model=await SearchModel(entry,data,input,"",ct);model.PageSize=pageSize;model.SortKey=sortKey;model.SortDirection=sortDirection;return View("Search",model);
    }
    [HttpPost("page")] public async Task<IActionResult> Page(PageRequest input,string tabId,CancellationToken ct) {
        await FormGuard(null,typeof(PageRequest),"TabId");var entry=contexts.Get(input.ContextId,identity.CurrentUser,tabId);try {var data=await coordinator.Page(input,tabId,ct);return View("Search",await SearchModel(entry,data,From(entry.Applied??new()),"",ct));}catch(WebFault e){ModelState.AddModelError(e.Field??"",e.Message);Response.StatusCode=e.Status;return View("Search",await SearchModel(entry,WebStudentCoordinator.Present(entry,null),From(entry.Applied??new()),"",ct));}
    }
    [HttpPost("clear")] public async Task<IActionResult> Clear(ContextRequest input,string tabId,CancellationToken ct) {await FormGuard(null,typeof(ContextRequest),"TabId");var data=await coordinator.Clear(input,tabId,ct);ModelState.Clear();var entry=contexts.Get(input.ContextId,identity.CurrentUser,tabId);return View("Search",await SearchModel(entry,data,new(),"",ct));}
    [HttpPost("options")] public async Task<IActionResult> Options([Bind(Prefix="Criteria")]StudentSearchInput input,string contextId,string contextRevision,string tabId,int pageSize=20,string sortKey="studentNo",string sortDirection="asc",CancellationToken ct=default) {await FormGuard("Criteria",typeof(StudentSearchInput),"ContextId","ContextRevision","TabId","PageSize","SortKey","SortDirection");if(!Request.Form.ContainsKey("Criteria.StatusCodes"))input.StatusCodes=[];var entry=contexts.Get(contextId,identity.CurrentUser,tabId);if(input.UnassignedOnly){input.SchoolYear=null;input.GradeCode=null;input.ClassId=null;ModelState.Remove("Criteria.SchoolYear");ModelState.Remove("Criteria.GradeCode");ModelState.Remove("Criteria.ClassId");}var model=await SearchModel(entry,WebStudentCoordinator.Present(entry,entry.LastResult),input,"条件を変更しました。検索を押すと一覧に反映します。",ct);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(input.ClassId)&&!model.Lookups.Classes.Any(c=>c.ClassId.ToString()==input.ClassId&&(input.SchoolYear is null||c.SchoolYear==input.SchoolYear)&&(string.IsNullOrEmpty(input.GradeCode)||c.GradeCode==input.GradeCode))){input.ClassId=null;ModelState.Remove("Criteria.ClassId");model.Message="上位条件に合わないクラスを解除しました。";}return View("Search",model);}
    [HttpGet("new")] public Task<IActionResult> New(string? returnContextId,CancellationToken ct)=>Load(null,returnContextId,ct);
    [HttpGet("{id:long}")] public Task<IActionResult> Edit(long id,string? returnContextId,CancellationToken ct)=>Load(id,returnContextId,ct);
    private async Task<IActionResult> Load(long? id,string? context,CancellationToken ct) {var data=await coordinator.Edit(id,context,ct);var returnRevision=string.IsNullOrEmpty(context)?null:contexts.Get(context,identity.CurrentUser).Revision.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);return View("Edit",new StudentEditPageModel {StudentId=id,Input=data.Form,Detail=data.Detail,Lookups=data.Lookups,User=identity.CurrentUser,ReturnRevision=returnRevision,SnapshotId=snapshots.Create(identity.CurrentUser,id,data.Detail,data.Form,returnRevision)});}
    [HttpPost("create")] public Task<IActionResult> Create([Bind(Prefix="Input")]StudentSaveInput input,string snapshotId,CancellationToken ct)=>Save(null,input,snapshotId,ct);
    [HttpPost("{id:long}/update")] public Task<IActionResult> Update(long id,[Bind(Prefix="Input")]StudentSaveInput input,string snapshotId,CancellationToken ct)=>Save(id,input,snapshotId,ct);
    private async Task<IActionResult> Save(long? id,StudentSaveInput input,string snapshotId,CancellationToken ct) {
        await FormGuard("Input",typeof(StudentSaveInput),"SnapshotId");identity.CreateOrUpdate();var snapshot=snapshots.Get(snapshotId,identity.CurrentUser,id);coordinator.CheckReturn(input.ReturnContextId);if(input.ReturnContextId!=snapshot.Original.ReturnContextId)throw new WebFault(403,"編集時と異なる復帰先は使用できません。");SaveResult? result=null;
        if(ModelState.IsValid) {try {result=await coordinator.Save(id,input,ct);foreach(var e in result.Errors)ModelState.AddModelError(e.Field,e.Message);}catch(WebFault e){ModelState.AddModelError(e.Field??"",e.Message);Response.StatusCode=e.Status;} } else Response.StatusCode=422;
        if(result?.Outcome==Outcome.Saved)return ReturnAfterSave(input.ReturnContextId,snapshot.ReturnRevision,"保存しました。");
        if(result is not null){Response.StatusCode=WebPresentation.Status(result.Outcome);input.DuplicateToken=result.ConfirmationToken;ModelState.Remove("Input.DuplicateToken");}
        return View("Edit",new StudentEditPageModel {StudentId=id,Input=input,Detail=snapshot.Detail,SnapshotId=snapshotId,ReturnRevision=snapshot.ReturnRevision,Result=result,Lookups=await service.LookupAsync(ct),User=identity.CurrentUser,Message=result?.Outcome==Outcome.NoChange?"変更はありません。":""});
    }
    [HttpPost("reset")] public async Task<IActionResult> Reset(string snapshotId,string? studentId,CancellationToken ct) {await FormGuard(null,typeof(EmptyInput),"SnapshotId","StudentId");identity.Read();var id=IdParser.Optional(studentId,"REG-INT-012");var snapshot=snapshots.Get(snapshotId,identity.CurrentUser,id);ModelState.Clear();return View("Edit",new StudentEditPageModel {StudentId=id,Input=EditorSnapshotStore.Copy(snapshot.Original),Detail=snapshot.Detail,SnapshotId=snapshotId,ReturnRevision=snapshot.ReturnRevision,Lookups=await service.LookupAsync(ct),User=identity.CurrentUser,Message="入力を読込時の値へ戻しました。"});}
    private sealed class EmptyInput { }
    [HttpPost("{id:long}/delete")] public async Task<IActionResult> Delete(long id,StudentDeleteInput input,string snapshotId,CancellationToken ct) {await FormGuard(null,typeof(StudentDeleteInput),"SnapshotId");identity.Read();var snapshot=snapshots.Get(snapshotId,identity.CurrentUser,id);if(input.ReturnContextId!=snapshot.Original.ReturnContextId)throw new WebFault(403,"編集時と異なる復帰先は使用できません。");var result=await coordinator.Delete(id,input,ct);if(result.Outcome==Outcome.Saved)return ReturnAfterSave(input.ReturnContextId,snapshot.ReturnRevision,"論理削除しました。");foreach(var e in result.Errors)ModelState.AddModelError(e.Field,e.Message);Response.StatusCode=WebPresentation.Status(result.Outcome);return await Load(id,input.ReturnContextId,ct);}
    private IActionResult ReturnAfterSave(string? context,string? revision,string message) {if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(context)){var entry=coordinator.NewContext();context=entry.Id;revision=entry.Revision.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);}flash.Put(identity.CurrentUser,context,message);Response.StatusCode=303;Response.Headers.Location="/students?contextId="+Uri.EscapeDataString(context)+"&contextRevision="+Uri.EscapeDataString(revision??"");return new EmptyResult();}
    private async Task<StudentSearchPageModel> SearchModel(SearchContextStore.Entry entry,object data,StudentSearchInput input,string message,CancellationToken ct)=>new() {Criteria=input,Lookups=await service.LookupAsync(false,ct),Context=entry,User=identity.CurrentUser,Data=StudentSearchPageModel.Json(data),Message=message,PageSize=entry.Applied?.PageSize??20,SortKey=entry.Applied?.SortKey??"studentNo",SortDirection=entry.Applied?.SortDirection??"asc"};
    private static StudentSearchInput From(SearchCriteria c)=>new() {StudentNo=c.StudentNo??"",Name=c.StudentName??"",Kana=c.StudentNameKana??"",SchoolYear=c.SchoolYear,GradeCode=c.GradeCode,ClassId=c.ClassId?.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),UnassignedOnly=c.UnassignedOnly,StatusCodes=c.EnrollmentStatusCodes,PrefectureCode=c.PrefectureCode,PhoneNumber=c.PhoneNumber??"",AdmissionFrom=c.AdmissionFrom,AdmissionTo=c.AdmissionTo};
    private async Task FormGuard(string? prefix,Type inputType,params string[] extras) {var allowed=new HashSet<string>(extras,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase){"__RequestVerificationToken","__Invariant"};foreach(var property in inputType.GetProperties()){var key=(prefix is null?"":prefix+".")+property.Name;if(property.PropertyType==typeof(BirthDateInput)){foreach(var component in new[]{"Era","Year","Month","Day"})allowed.Add(key+"."+component);}else allowed.Add(key);}var form=await Request.ReadFormAsync();foreach(var key in form.Keys){if(!allowed.Contains(key))throw new WebFault(400,"許可されていない項目が送信されました。");if(key=="__Invariant"&&form[key].Any(value=>value is null||!allowed.Contains(value)))throw new WebFault(400,"不正なフォーム書式メタ情報です。");if(form[key].Count>1&&key!="__Invariant"&&!key.EndsWith("StatusCodes",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)&&!key.EndsWith("UnassignedOnly",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))throw new WebFault(400,"同名項目が重複しています。");}}
}
